tooltip.convergence.field_atlas: Right-click for expedition guidance. Sneak + right-click for your current commission.
tooltip.convergence.attunement_core: Hold in your offhand when opening an Adept or Exalted Rift to enter Convergence mode. One core is consumed on activation.
tooltip.convergence.concordance: One trophy per surviving participant after a successful Adept or Exalted Convergence trial.
tooltip.convergence.confluence_filament: Earned from threefold commissions. Powers Triune Pulses and Mender Coils; used in expedition equipment.
tooltip.convergence.tempered_focus: A commission milestone catalyst. Combine with Concordance to assemble advanced equipment.
tooltip.convergence.harmonic_matrix: Earned at commissions 12 and 18. A lattice for the strongest expedition devices.
tooltip.convergence.astral_lens: Offhand: Night Vision. Its glow fades up to 13 seconds after removing the lens.
tooltip.convergence.stormward_sigil: Offhand: Fire Resistance and Water Breathing. Convergence damage can still harm you.
tooltip.convergence.expedition_harness: Offhand: Speed I, Jump Boost II and Slow Falling. Effects fade within two seconds.
tooltip.convergence.triune_pulse: Right-click: repel and slow up to six visible hostiles within six blocks. Costs one Filament; 15-second cooldown.
tooltip.convergence.mender_coil: Main hand + right-click: repair the damaged item in your offhand by up to 64 durability. Costs one Filament; 20-second cooldown.
message.convergence.status: Threefold commissions: %s complete | circuit %s, commission %s/18 | Rift tier %s/3 | guild deliveries %s
message.convergence.gates: Requires Rift completion tier %s and %s Copperwake guild deliveries.
message.convergence.turnin_hint: Use /convergence turnin with the entire order in your inventory. All listed supplies are consumed together.
message.convergence.circuit_complete: Harmonic horizon reached! The next circuit repeats these expeditions with more materials and the same rewards.
message.convergence.failure.survival_onl: Use Survival or Adventure mode while alive to deliver commissions or power expedition devices.
message.convergence.failure.rift_locked: Complete the required Riftbound tier first. Nothing was consumed.
message.convergence.failure.guild_locked: Complete the required Copperwake guild deliveries first. Nothing was consumed.
message.convergence.failure.missing_item: The order is incomplete. Nothing was consumed. Use /convergence contract to see missing supplies.
message.convergence.failure.max_progress: Your commission counter has reached its limit. Nothing was consumed.
message.convergence.pulse_empty: No visible hostile within six blocks. No Filament was consumed.
message.convergence.pulse_result: Triune pulse repelled and slowed %s hostile(s).
message.convergence.repair_mainhand: Put the Mender Coil in your main hand and the damaged equipment in your offhand.
message.convergence.repair_target: Your offhand item has no durability damage. No Filament was consumed.
message.convergence.filament_needed: You need one Confluence Filament from commissions to power this device.
message.convergence.kit: Operator expedition equipment granted. Rift and guild progression are unchanged; trial trophies still require victories.
message.convergence.help: /convergence status: saved progress; /convergence contract: current fixed delivery; /convergence turnin: deliver all supplies atomically. Craft a Field Atlas for the route. Operators: /convergence kit.
message.convergence.atlas.1: 1. Explore Copperwake's Rustwild for Scrap and Memory Glass. Complete four guild deliveries to reach Mechanist, then twelve to reach Artificer.
message.convergence.atlas.2: 2. Hunt Starfall meteor craters at night. Gather Star Shards and Stardust, then forge Starsteel for advanced commissions and equipment.
message.convergence.atlas.3: 3. Clear Riftbound Initiate trials for Resonance Shards. Craft an Attunement Core from four Resonance Shards, four Star Shards and one Charged Core.
message.convergence.atlas.4: 4. Hold an Attunement Core in your offhand when opening an unlocked Adept or Exalted Rift. One Core is consumed. Clear the Convergence trial to earn Concordance.
message.convergence.atlas.5: 5. Deliver the 18 fixed commissions with /convergence turnin. Commissions 6, 12 and 18 need fresh Convergence trophies; 17 needs a Foundry Foreman Heart.
message.convergence.atlas.6: 6. Spend Filaments, Focuses, Matrices and Concordance on offhand relics or expedition gadgets. Later circuits need 2x then 3x materials; trophy costs and rewards stay fixed. Craft an Astral Infusion Station to exchange extra Rift materials for fewer Filaments under the clear night sky.
contract.convergence.first_signal.title: The First Signal
contract.convergence.first_signal.descri: A copper relay hears a note inside the fallen stars. Bring resonance, salvage and sky crystal to prove the worlds share a frequency.
contract.convergence.copper_constellatio: Mount a ring of starstone on gears. The new observatory must follow both the sky and the forgotten machines.
Memory glass refuses to remember rain. Prismarine and stardust might teach the rifts how to chart an ocean.
contract.convergence.verdant_observatory: The Mechanists want a living lens. Stabilize their salvaged frame with verdant echoes and meteoric shards.
contract.convergence.buried_star_chart.d: A deepslate chart records an eclipse that has not happened. Starsteel teeth can turn its silent calendar.
contract.convergence.adept_concord.title: The Adept Concord
contract.convergence.adept_concord.descr: Return from an Adept or Exalted Convergence trial with Concordance. Only a hard-won agreement can lock this charged relay into tune.
contract.convergence.ember_relay.title: Carry the Ember Relay
contract.convergence.ember_relay.descrip: The cinder works need a heat memory. Seal ember echoes behind glass and use stardust to keep their message alive.
contract.convergence.frost_clock.title: The Frost Clock
contract.convergence.frost_clock.descrip: A frozen clock skips every third hour. Fit sky-forged hands to the copper movement before the ice forgets winter.
contract.convergence.storm_salvage.title: Salvage the Storm
contract.convergence.storm_salvage.descr: Build lightning rods for an array fed by charged cores, star shards and the dangerous hum of a stronger rift.
contract.convergence.hollow_navigation.d: The Artificers found a route without a sky. Hollow echoes and memory glass will carry a map where compasses fail.
contract.convergence.artificer_lantern.d: A lantern that shines across dimensions needs starsteel shutters, glowstone and a mechanism that never loses its rhythm.
contract.convergence.exalted_concord.des: Complete Exalted Rift progression and return with another Convergence trophy. The first Harmonic Matrix will connect all three worlds.
contract.convergence.tide_archive.title: Archive the Tides
contract.convergence.tide_archive.descri: Record every shore in tidal echoes. Glass, stardust and resonance will keep the archive from being washed away.
contract.convergence.sky_foundry.title: The Sky Foundry
contract.convergence.sky_foundry.descrip: Fire from the Nether must meet steel from the stars. Fit the foundry with copper gears and rift-tempered calibration.
contract.convergence.void_beacon.title: A Beacon Beyond the Void
contract.convergence.void_beacon.descrip: Ender pearls bend its beam toward impossible destinations. Feed the beacon a fresh charge from all three expeditions.
contract.convergence.threefold_map.title: The Threefold Map
contract.convergence.threefold_map.descr: The ancient city left a final echo. Combine it with glass memories and sky dust to chart the spaces between worlds.
contract.convergence.foreman_eclipse.des: Defeat a Foundry Foreman in the Rustwild and bring its Heart. The sky foundry cannot wake until its old master rests.
contract.convergence.harmonic_horizon.de: Bring two fresh Concordances and a full triune offering. The horizon answers, completing the circuit and opening the next expedition.
advancement.convergence.root.title: Three Worlds, One Route
advancement.convergence.root.description: Craft a Field Atlas and begin the Threefold Expeditions.
advancement.convergence.attunement.title: A Shared Frequency
advancement.convergence.attunement.descr: Assemble an Attunement Core from all three mods.
advancement.convergence.concord.title: A Hard-Won Concord
advancement.convergence.concord.descript: Survive a Convergence trial and receive Concordance.
advancement.convergence.focus.title: Focus the Expedition
advancement.convergence.focus.descriptio: Earn a Tempered Focus from an authored commission.
advancement.convergence.matrix.title: Across the Harmonic Horizon
advancement.convergence.matrix.descripti: Reach a late commission milestone and earn a Harmonic Matrix.
tooltip.convergence.astral_infuser: Clear Overworld night + open sky: infuse earned relics using fewer Filaments. Sneak + right-click for all four recipes.
advancement.convergence.infuser.title: A Workshop Under the Stars
advancement.convergence.infuser.descript: Craft an Astral Infusion Station from Rift resonance, copper mechanisms and Starsteel.
message.convergence.infusion.layout: Grid: top = Rift / Copper / Starsteel; middle = Concordance / Focus / Matrix; bottom = Filament / output / output.
message.convergence.infusion.hint: Ten seconds per relic under a clear Overworld night and open sky. Sneak + right-click the station for exact recipes. Inputs remain until a relic is ready.
message.convergence.infusion.recipe.verd: Astral Lens: 2 Verdant Echo, 2 Memory Glass, 1 Starsteel, 1 Concordance, 1 Focus, no Matrix, 2 Filaments.
message.convergence.infusion.recipe.tida: Stormward Sigil: 2 Tidal Echo, 2 Charged Cores, 2 Starsteel, 2 Concordances, no Focus, 1 Matrix, 1 Filament.
message.convergence.infusion.recipe.holl: Expedition Harness: 2 Hollow Echo, 2 Brass Gears, 2 Starsteel, 1 Concordance, 2 Focuses, 1 Matrix, 2 Filaments.
message.convergence.infusion.recipe.embe: Mender Coil: 2 Ember Echo, 2 Brass Gears, 1 Starsteel, 1 Concordance, 1 Focus, no Matrix, 2 Filaments.
message.convergence.infusion.status.inco: Incomplete infusion: use the seven input positions. Sneak + right-click for recipes.
message.convergence.infusion.status.nigh: %s paused: needs clear Overworld night and open sky (%s/%s seconds).
message.convergence.infusion.status.full: %s paused: both output slots are full (%s/%s seconds).
message.convergence.infusion.status.read: Output ready: retrieve your relic. Add a complete formula to begin another infusion.
